long_biography.plain_text:
A Geneva law graduate, Bertherat entered finance at Kleinwort Benson before moving to Pictet's private-client division. His five years establishing the Luxembourg operation created the group's second-largest location outside Geneva and positioned it as a centre for European development. Partnership ownership later combined this operating record with a direct economic stake in the bank.

Bertherat went on to direct international growth, securing a Hong Kong banking licence, building an Asian management platform and opening offices in Tel Aviv and Munich. Executive retirement shifted his public attention toward contemporary photography, museum governance and philanthropy. He currently chairs MAMCO's foundation and sits as an independent director of CIR.
